name: Elders In The Church
overview: Scripture reveals that elders hold a vital leadership role within the early church, entrusted with oversight and shepherding responsibilities. The apostles appointed elders in every church to provide spiritual guidance and care, as seen in Acts 14:23 and Titus 1:5. Elders are recognized as overseers of the flock, called to feed and protect the church purchased by Christ’s blood, exemplified in Acts 20:28. Their authority and role were affirmed through prayer, fasting, and communal recognition, emphasizing their importance in maintaining doctrinal integrity and unity, as reflected in Acts 11:30, 15:2, and 20:17.
